name: Crowd Fighter
description: Thrives in chaotic multi-combatant situations where confusion is an advantage
behavioral_signature: More dangerous when surrounded than when facing one opponent
under_stress: Gets isolated and loses their advantage
at_rest: Studying crowd movement and mass combat dynamics
will_always: prefer many opponents to one skilled fighter
will_never: agree to single combat when a melee is available
unless: the single opponent is too dangerous to let reach the crowd
